title: Reverse Odd Levels of Binary Tree
summary: Given a perfect binary tree, reverse the node values at each odd level.
statement: Given a perfect binary tree, reverse the node values at each odd level. For instance, if level 3 values are [2,1,3,4,7,11,29,18], they become [18,29,11,7,4,3,1,2]. Return the modified tree root. A perfect binary tree has all parent nodes with two children and all leaf nodes at the same level. The level of a node is the path length from the node to the root.
constraints: root is a perfect binary tree with unique values.
Reverse node values at every odd-numbered depth; keep the tree structure unchanged.
